name: Microsoft365DSC
short_description: Open-source PowerShell module that uses Desired State Configuration to export, configure, compare and monitor Microsoft 365 tenant configuration as code, including drift detection.

evidence.quote: It might come from M365DSC from UTCM as that matures
Microsoft 365 desired state configuration or an equivalent framework must be your only source of truth.
You should implement Microsoft 365 DSC to establish a baseline configuration for all your tenants.
